name: aomega-m3-pretzel-level2-stokes
description: The (-2,3,7) pretzel's level-2 descendant q-difference operator, derived from its state integral by contour shift + Faddeev's functional equation; its q -> 0 exponents by Newton polygon; and the s(x) = x + 1 + 1/x verdict.  Gated on 4_1 and 5_2, where the same derivation reproduces GGM (276)/(332) exactly and GGM print the q -> 0 Stokes matrices (188)/(307).

parameters.symbolic: exact sympy over Q(q^{1/2}, x^{1/2}, w); no float64 anywhere
held_sources: library/arxiv-2012.00062v3 (GGM, Peacock patterns and resurgence in complex Chern-Simons theory): (186), (187a), (188), (239), (276), (305a), (307), (321), (326), (327), (331), (332)

integrands.4_1: int Phi_b(v+u) Phi_b(v) e^{-pi i v^2 + 2 pi i v t} dv
integrands.5_2: int Phi_b(v) Phi_b(v+u) Phi_b(v-u) e^{-2 pi i v^2 + 2 pi i v t} dv

verdict: DERIVED, from held text only (GK arxiv-1304.2705v1 (1) for Phi_b; GGM arxiv-2012.00062v3 (188), (239), (276), (307), (321), (332)).  The descendant q-difference operator of a one-dimensional state integral follows from the contour shift v -> v - i b and Faddeev's functional equation: P(X) = q^{A/2} w N(X) - X^A with N the product of the shift factors. Its q -> 0 characteristic roots are the exponents the q -> 0 Stokes matrix is built from. GATE 5_2: offsets {1, x, 1/x} -- the adjoint weight set -- give N = (1, s, s, 1), reproducing GGM (276) EXACTLY; s(x) is e1 = e2 of that set, which is the mechanism behind GGM (307).  GATE 4_1: offsets {x, 1}, N = (1, 1+x, x), and s(x) = (1 + x + x^2)/x surfaces in (188) through the (327) theta-renormalisation.  PRETZEL (-2,3,7): the doubled dilogarithm Phi_b(2v - c_b) shifts by -2 i b and contributes TWO factors, so the operator has DEGREE 6 -- the rank, confirmed independently of GZ.  Its x-dependence is entirely through sigma = x^{1/2} + x^{-1/2} = s(x^{1/2}) - 1.  The Newton polygon splits the six exponents 2 + 4 across a q^{1/2} step, and the x-dependent pair are the roots of Y^2 + sigma Y + 1, i.e. -x^{1/2} and -x^{-1/2}.  S(X) VERDICT: NO -- the pretzel's q -> 0 Stokes data is not built from s(x) = x + 1 + 1/x. It is built from sigma = s(x^{1/2}) - 1, which satisfies sigma^2 = s(x) + 1 and generates a DEGREE-2 extension of Z[s(x)].  The operator carries an exact Z/2 grading in which sigma is odd precisely when q is half-integral, so 'level 2' and 'the quadratic extension of Z[s(x)]' are the same phenomenon.  The refinement that follows: Stokes entries at INTEGER powers of q carry EVEN powers of sigma and therefore DO lie in Z[s(x)] -- consistent with the parent session's independently derived sigma_1 sigma_1 rotated index, whose coefficients are polynomials in s(zeta) with integer powers of zeta only -- while entries at HALF-INTEGER powers of q carry odd powers of sigma and do not.  SCOPE (a).  This is a statement about the q -> 0 exponents of the derived descendant operator, hence about the RING the Stokes entries lie in.  It does NOT produce the pretzel's S+(x;q) entry by entry: GGM fix the left and right GL(r) normalisation matrices per knot ((187a) for 4_1, (305a) for 5_2), and those come from the four region matrices M_R(x;q) ((186a)-(186d) for 4_1, (94a)-(94d) for 5_2).  No held source prints the analogue for a rank-6, level-2 knot; that is the precise missing input, and it is a normalisation, not new q-series data.

assertions.label: G2-4_1: N(X) = 1 + q^{-1/2}(1 + x) X + q^{-1} x X^2, i.e. prod over the pole offsets {x, 1} -- GGM (332) with (A, r) = (1, 2).  Elementary symmetric functions e1 = 1 + x, e2 = x; s(x) = (1 + x + x^2)/x = (e1^2 - e2)/e2 is what appears in GGM (188) after the (327) theta-renormalisation.

G1-5_2: N(X) = 1 + q^{-1/2} s(x) X + q^{-1} s(x) X^2 + q^{-3/2} X^3, i.e. coefficients (1, s, s, 1) -- EXACTLY GGM (276) / (332) with pole offsets {1, x, 1/x}, the ADJOINT WEIGHT SET.  This is where s(x) comes from: it is e1 = e2 of that set.

G5-rank: the derived pretzel operator has degree 6 -- the pretzel's rank 6 (GZ's twelve level-2 series H_j^pm, j = 0..5, six per side).  The two unit dilogarithms give degree 2; the DOUBLED dilogarithm Phi_b(2v - c_b) shifts by -2 i b and gives degree 4, not 2.
G8a-pretzel: every coefficient of N(X) is invariant under x^{1/2} -> x^{-1/2}, so the x-dependence is entirely through sigma = x^{1/2} + x^{-1/2} = s(x^{1/2}) - 1.

G8b-pretzel LEVEL GRADING: P(X) is invariant under the simultaneous flip (q^{1/2}, x^{1/2}) -> (-q^{1/2}, -x^{1/2}).  Equivalently sigma appears to an ODD power exactly when q appears to a HALF-INTEGER power.  That is level 2: the deck transformation of the double cover x = (x^{1/2})^2 is tied to the deck transformation of q^{1/2}.

G8c-the extension: sigma^2 = s(x) + 1, and Y^2 - (S + 1) is irreducible over Q(S).  So sigma = sqrt(s(x) + 1) generates a DEGREE-2 extension of Z[s(x)] and is NOT a polynomial in s(x).  Even powers of sigma lie in Z[s(x)]; odd powers do not.

G7a-5_2 exponents: the (single) Newton segment has slope -1/2 and leading polynomial proportional to Y^3 + s Y^2 + s Y + 1 = (Y + 1)(Y^2 + (x + 1/x) Y + 1), roots Y in {-1, -x, -1/x}.  The q -> 0 exponents are the ADJOINT WEIGHT SET of x, up to sign -- which is why s(x) = e1 = e2 appears in GGM (188) / (307).

G7b-PRETZEL exponents: the Newton polygon splits 2 + 4 across a q^{1/2} step -- the level-2 signature.  The long (4-root) segment's leading polynomial is divisible by Y^2 + sigma Y + 1, whose roots are Y = -x^{1/2} and Y = -x^{-1/2}.  So the x-dependent q -> 0 exponents of the pretzel are the adjoint weights of x^{1/2}, NOT of x.

G6-the criterion: GGM (188) for 4_1 and (307) for 5_2, multiplied out, have every entry in Z[s(x)]: 4_1 gives [[1, s], [0, 1]] and 5_2 gives [[1, s+1, 0], [0, 1, 0], [-s, -s^2, 1]]. At x = 1, s(1) = 3, and these are GGM (59) / (96) with Stokes constants 3 and (4, 3, 3).

G3-the (FE)-rearranged integrand identity  integrand(v - i b)/integrand(v) = q^{A/2} w X^{-A} N(X)  holds pointwise for ALL THREE knots (mpmath, dps 30; two values of b, three of v each).  This validates the operator algebra of (OP) independently of any contour.

G4-4_1: the derived recurrence sum_j c_j Z(t - i (j - A) b) = 0 holds on the ACTUAL state integral (mpmath, dps 30, two (b, eps) choices, t_I centred in the common convergence window).  degree 2.  This tests the contour shift as well as the algebra.  The residual here is QUADRATURE-limited, not arithmetic-limited: the integrand is a Gaussian chirp whose oscillation frequency grows linearly in |v|, so mp.quad's node density -- not dps -- sets the floor.  G3 is the exact algebraic gate (~1e-29); this one corroborates the CONTOUR SHIFT, which G3 cannot see.
